description: The Southern Photometric Local Universe Survey (S-PLUS) utilizes a dedicated 0.82-meter robotic telescope (T80-South) at CTIO, equipped with a 12-filter optical system featuring 5 SDSS-like broad bands and 7 narrow bands.
facility_description: The T80-South telescope is a robotic facility located at Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory (CTIO) in Chile.
notes: T80-South operates as a tenant facility on Cerro Tololo. S-PLUS data and filter curves are maintained by the collaboration.
